cues: Do not confuse it with dew.
Guttation is xylem sap from inside, pushed by root pressure, out of hydathodes, and it dries to a white crust.
Dew is atmospheric vapour condensing on any cold surface, even a stone, and it is pure water.
And bleeding is different again: sap flowing from a cut.
